section_summary.extract_value: This section presents further analyses of body appreciation data, focusing on the General Body Appreciation factor after excluding the Body Image Investment factor due to low internal consistency. ANOVA results show no significant main effect of ethnicity (Javanese, Sundanese, Chinese) and no ethnicity-by-gender interaction, but a significant main effect of gender with women reporting lower body appreciation than men. Importantly, General Body Appreciation was significantly negatively correlated with BMI for both women (r = -.30) and men (r = -.22).
